properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 24 at 5:00PM MDT until October 24 at 7:15PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding continues, especially along the Conejos River.

* WHERE...Southwestern Saguache, Central Mineral and Western Rio
Grande Counties...

* WHEN...Until 715 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 457 PM MDT, High water levels in area creeks and streams
continue, although many locations in the San Juan Mountains have
crested and have begun to slowly fall. Over the western portion
of the San Luis Valley, many streams and creeks are near crest
now and will slowly fall for the remainder of the day. The
Conejos River at Mogote has crested, but will likely remain above
flood stage until early Monday morning.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Platoro, Mogote.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 24 at 2:56PM AKDT until October 24 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Freezing rain and snow. Snow accumulations up to one inch.
Ice accumulations up to a tenth of an inch.

* WHERE...Central Susitna Valley, including Talkeetna.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Areas of mixed precipitation have developed
across parts of the Central Susitna Valley this afternoon,
including a mix of freezing rain and snow.  The highest potential
for minor ice accumulations is anticipated along the Talkeetna Spur
Road and near Talkeetna, where temperatures could remain at or
below freezing through this evening.  Temperatures will gradually
rise above freezing by the overnight hours tonight, allowing
freezing rain to transition to plain rain.
properties.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

properties.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 24 at 6:52PM EDT until October 25 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, up to one foot of
inundation above ground level along shorelines and tidal
waterways (7.3 to 7.5 feet Mean Lower Low Water at Charleston).
For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 4 to 6 feet
in the surf zone. For the High Rip Current Risk, dangerous rip
currents. For the Coastal Flood Watch, one to two feet of
inundation above ground level possible along shorelines and
tidal waterways (7.9 to 8.1 feet Mean Lower Low Water at
Charleston).

* WHERE...Coastal Colleton and Charleston Counties.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 10 PM EDT this
evening. For the High Surf Advisory, until 5 PM EDT Monday.
For the High Rip Current Risk, through Sunday evening. For the
Coastal Flood Watch, from 4 AM EDT Sunday through Sunday
morning.

* IMPACTS...Significant saltwater inundation will render
numerous roads impassable. Properties may also flood.
Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and localized beach
erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tide will occur around 7:13 PM today
and around 7:34 AM Sunday at Charleston. Saltwater inundation
will be possible 1 to 2 hours before and after high tide.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Visit water.weather.gov for additional water level and flood
impact information.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

properties.description:

river is running fast and high. Do not attempt to cross.

morning between the Four Corners and Bluff, cresting between

by midnight Sunday night.

Aneth.
